form.title: Heart rate monitor
menu.doNotScaleFont.tooltip: Do not automatically scale the font with the window. The font can be set inside the "Select window font" dialog.
menu.setHeartRateFile.tooltip: The full path of where to write the last heart rate to.  Supports date syntax.
menu.setCSVOutputFile.tooltip: The full path of where to write the logged data to.  If empty, no file log is kept.  Log is written in CSV format.
menu.setIBIFile.tooltip: The full path of where to write the IBI data to. Writes log of RR-Intervals in milliseconds in IBI supported file format. Supports date syntax like `LogFile` does.
error.loadBackgroundImage: Unable to load background image file "{0}" due to error: {1}
service.deviceNotFound: Unable to locate heart rate device. Ensure it's connected and paired.
service.cannotGetService: Unable to get service to {0} ({1}). Is the device in use by another program? The Bluetooth adaptor may need to be turned off and on again.
service.cannotLocateMeasurement: Unable to locate heart rate measurement on device {0} ({1}).
